description.text: One of the two sixth expansions of the Sword & Shield series, released together with Jet-Black Spirit on 23 April 2021, with Pokémon from The Crown Tundra, the second downloadable expansion of Pokémon Sword and Shield. Silver Lance holds Ice Rider Calyrex VMAX and Tornadus VMAX, a Single Strike card whose attack does 240 damage and discards the Stadium in play, with Galarian Rapidash V, Volcanion V and Sandaconda VMAX. The two packs also share four forms of Castform, which can attack without Energy when its player has eight Stadiums in the discard pile. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 70, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon V and Supporters, some Pokémon V in a second version drawn as a full scene, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon VMAX and Supporters with a second Ice Rider Calyrex VMAX drawn as a full scene, and gold Ultra Rare Bronzong, Welcoming Lantern, Rugged Helmet and Water Energy. In English many of its cards came out in Chilling Reign in June 2021, and some in Evolving Skies in August 2021.
